convert_benchmark_json_to_csv: run bm2bq.py with a benchmark json file to convert it to BigQuery-compatible CSV output
print_bigquery_schema: run bm2bq.py with the --schema flag to print the BigQuery column schema
convert_json_with_baseline: run bm2bq.py with two json files to compare benchmark results against a baseline
sanitize_types_for_bigquery: use the SANITIZE dictionary to convert string values to integer, float, boolean, or timestamp types
fetch_bigquery_columns: use the columns list fetched via the bq CLI to get BigQuery schema field names and types
